question: If an opponent controls Anointed Procession, do I get twice as many tokens from Crafty Cutpurse's replacement effect?

expected.shortAnswer: No: Crafty Cutpurse's effect is applied before Anointed Procession's, so you do not get twice as many tokens.
expected.answer: Crafty Cutpurse’s replacement effect is applied before any other replacement effects that would also modify how the token enters the battlefield. For example, if an opponent controls Anointed Procession, your Crafty Cutpurse’s effect applies before that of Anointed Procession and you won’t get twice as many tokens.
